name: How long does a typical ceiling leak assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical ceiling leak assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a ceiling leak assessment can vary depending on the complexity of the leak and the accessibility of the affected areas. Most standard assessments are completed within 1 to 2 hours. However, more intricate leaks, especially those with multiple potential sources or hidden damage, may require additional time for a comprehensive investigation. We aim to provide an accurate estimate of the assessment time during scheduling based on your initial description of the issue.
